name: Drag lift
steps: t0: long-press recognised → haptic LONG_PRESS
0–180ms: scale 1 → 1.04, rotate 0 → −2°, shadow card → lift (lift)
while dragging: card follows pointer 1:1; rotation = clamp(velocityX × 0.02, −3°, 3°), eased 120ms
origin slot: dashed outline (2.5px, line-strong 25%) at card height
neighbours: when card centre crosses a neighbour midpoint, neighbour springs to new slot (settle 320ms, +6px overshoot); haptic SEGMENT_TICK
drop: card springs into slot (settle 260ms), scale → 1, rotate → 0, shadow → card
reduced: No scale/tilt; card gets 2px ink outline + shadow; neighbours jump.

name: Drop target (tab / lane)
where: Phone: Column tabs while card above list area; desktop: lanes
steps: phone: card above y < tabs+60px → card scales to 0.5 over 280ms so tabs stay visible

enter target: target grows 1.16 (phone tab) / 1.012 (lane), fills with its accent, glow ring 7px accent 35%; others dim to 45% / 60%; background tints 22% toward target · pop 240ms; haptic GESTURE_THRESHOLD_ACTIVATE
hover: wiggle ±3° (tab) / ±0.3° (lane) 600ms, repeats every 1.2s
leave: reverse in 200ms
drop on tab: card scales to 0.05 + rotate −40° into tab 420ms (swoosh); tab squash 1.32/.84 → .9/1.1 → 1; count rolls; 5-pebble burst; slot collapses 400ms, list closes up · haptic CONFIRM
drop on current Column tab: card moves to top of list
drop on lane (desktop): coloured slot opens at insert index (dashed accent, 128px), card settles into it
reduced: Target: accent fill + ring only, no scale/wiggle. Drop: card fades; count swaps.

name: Gekocht celebration + toast
steps: 0ms: press scale .94 (tap); haptic CONFIRM on release
0–480ms: button springs 1.12 → 1, fills sage, check draws (stroke-dashoffset 20 → 0, 260ms from +120ms)
0–620ms: veggie confetti (native Vue/SVG particles, 14 pieces, gravity arc; not video)
+300ms: card leaves Column (slides +440px, rotate 8°, 360ms swoosh), list closes up (settle)
+320ms: Gekocht tab bumps 1.22 + count rolls up
+500ms: toast springs in (380ms settle); Topfbert clip pops up behind toast (+100ms) and plays "Mmh!"
toast: "Gekocht · Notiz hinzufügen · Rückgängig"; undo window 5s (progress bar); FAB moves up 76px
5s: toast out 300ms; Rückgängig reverses all (card flies back 480ms)
10th cooking: after toast in, 10× milestone plays (420ms delay)
reduced: Button colour + check, card fades out, toast fades in. No confetti, Topfbert still frame.

name: Swipe between Columns
steps: horizontal pan > 8px and |dx| > 1.2|dy| → capture; list follows finger 1:1
edges: rubber-band 0.3×
progress p = idx − dx/width drives: headline translateX(offset × 70px) + opacity 1 − |offset| × 1.6; active tab pill position; background colour mix
release: |dx| > 18% width or velocity > 0.5px/ms → next Column; spring settle 480ms; haptic SEGMENT_TICK
background colour cross-fades 600ms to new Column tint
reduced: Swipe still pages; release snaps in 150ms fade; no parallax.

name: Card → detail morph
where: Tap card (phone full-screen, desktop side panel)
steps: shared element: card thumbnail → header image; interpolate left/top/width/height/border-radius (20px → 0) over 600ms swoosh
phone: Board behind scales to 0.94, detail background fades in (0–30%); content panel rises from +90px (from 30%, 420ms settle)
desktop: 480px panel slides from +100% x (480ms sheet); Board dims (scrim)
buttons (back, …) pop in at 80% (pop)
placeholder illustrations start their loop once morph ends
close / back gesture: exact reverse; image lands in card
Nuxt: use View Transitions API (view-transition-name per card image) with a fallback FLIP implementation
reduced: Detail cross-fades in 200ms; no scale of Board.

name: Sheet open / close
steps: open: scrim fades 0 → 1 (260ms); sheet translateY(100%) → 0 (440ms sheet, ~10px overshoot)
contents: first section rises 14px from +150ms (fade)
drag handle: follows finger, resistance 0.5 upwards; release > 25% height or velocity > 0.8 → close
close: translateY(100%) 320ms ease-in, scrim out 240ms
keyboard: sheet sits on top of keyboard; keyboard rises 360ms
stacked sheet: parent scales 0.96 and dims 20%
desktop ≥768px: sheet renders as Dialog (scale .92 → 1, 360ms)

name: Reorder a Recipe line
where: RecipeEditor, Zutaten and Schritte (each list on its own; no dragging between lists)
steps: t0: long-press grip 300ms (touch) or mouse-down on grip + 4px (pointer: fine) → haptic LONG_PRESS
0–180ms: line scale 1 → 1.03, rotate 0 → −1.5°, shadow → shadow.lift, surface fill (lift), same as Columns in Board Settings
origin: dashed slot 2px line-strong, radius.field, height = line height

while dragging: line follows the pointer on y only; neighbours spring to their new slot when the line centre crosses their midpoint (settle 320ms, +4px overshoot) · haptic SEGMENT_TICK; Step numbers update with each swap (number rolls 12px, 200ms)
near sheet edge (48px): autoscroll up to 12px/frame
drop: line settles into the slot (settle 260), scale 1, rotate 0, shadow none

keyboard / screen reader: grip button opens menu "Nach oben" / "Nach unten" (pop 460); Alt+↑/↓ on desktop; line moves to its slot (settle 480), focus stays on its grip; live region: "{line}, jetzt an Stelle {n} von {total}."
reduced: No scale or tilt: 2px text outline + shadow.lift. Neighbours and keyboard moves jump to their slot. Numbers swap.

name: Paste lines
where: Any RecipeLine textarea in the editor
steps: paste event with \n in the text → preventDefault
split on line breaks; trim; drop empty lines; strip a leading "•", "-", "*", "–", "1.", "1)"
first piece replaces the selection in the current line (text before the caret stays), the rest become new lines below it; the text after the caret goes to the end of the last new line
cap at 60 Zutaten / 40 Schritte and 200 / 1000 characters per line (longer pieces are cut at the limit)
0ms: new lines insert at full height; each fades 0 → 1 with 30ms stagger (max 8, rest together)
0–1600ms: new lines tinted color.paste-tint, ease-out to transparent
+120ms: Toast "{n} Zutaten eingefügt" / "{n} Schritte eingefügt" + Rückgängig (5s); over the limit: "{k} Zeilen haben nicht mehr reingepasst."
caret to the end of the last new line; scroll it 24px above the keyboard
reduced: Lines appear at once; tint holds 1.6s then switches off; toast fades in.

name: A found Recipe arrives
where: Dish detail, RecipeSection slot, for every Member watching the Dish (realtime)
steps: result arrives (realtime) while "Rezept wird gesucht" is shown
0–300ms: Topfbert search hops (y −7) and shrinks to .7 + fades; the card scales .97 + fades (ease-in)
300ms: card removed; RecipeSection mounts. Content above is unchanged, so scroll position never moves
300–540ms: "Rezept" header fades in (fade 240)
380–860ms: Zutaten card rises 14px + fades (settle 480)
460ms+: Zutaten lines rise 10px + fade (420 settle), stagger 60ms, max 8, the rest with the 8th
Zutaten start + 8×60 + 120ms: Schritte card rises, its lines stagger the same way
if the slot is not in the viewport: no animation is seen; Toast "Rezept gefunden" + "Zeigen" (scrolls to the Recipe, swoosh 600)
haptic: none (it is not the user's own action)
reduced: Search card crossfades to the finished lists in 200ms. No hop, no rise, no stagger.

name: Recipe switch (long Recipes)
where: Dish detail, when RecipeSection is taller than 2 viewports and both lists exist
steps: show when the Zutaten card top passes under the top bar; hide when the source line / end of Schritte passes
show: fade 240 + y −8 → 0; hide: reverse
active = Schritte once the Schritte card top is within 60px under the switch
tap: smooth scroll (swoosh 600) to the list heading, 12px under the switch; active swaps on arrival
